newsitem.title: USA: CSCE world sugar called to open little changed.
newsitem.headline: CSCE world sugar called to open little changed.

text.p: CSCE world sugar was called to open mostly unchanged Wednesday, dealers said.
Prices are seen firming during the session, however, with benchmark July expected to test the resistance at the recent high of 10.21 cents a lb.
Tuesday, July closed 0.05 cent firmer at 11.16 cents, traded 11.17 to 11.04 cents. The rest settled 0.03 to 0.06 higher.
An estimated 11,872 lots changed hands on the day.
LIFFE white sugar futures firmed slightly on Wednesday, with benchmark August up $0.40 to $320.60, at 0841 EDT/1241 GMT. The rest of the board stood $0.40 higher to $0.50 lower.
